scope: Public product leaderboard on harpd.com. The dataset describes Harpd Rank participation only and does not represent the entire product market.

rankPoints.rule: One completed Harpd Credit spend on Rank creates one permanent Rank Point.
rankPoints.permanence: Overall Rank Points never reset. Monthly and Weekly boards aggregate Rank Points earned inside the UTC period; closed periods become immutable snapshots.
rankPoints.disclosure: Rank Points are promotional placement, not an editorial recommendation. Paying for placement does not equal product quality.

boards.overall: Lifetime leaderboard ordered by all completed Rank Points.

entry.freeListing: Every approved product enters Overall Rank for free at 0 Rank Points.
entry.verification: Promotional Rank spending requires a verified maker claim. Verification is not an endorsement.
entry.referenceProducts: Harpd-operated and unclaimed editorial reference listings are excluded from Maker Rank.

trending: Trending is organic and independent of Rank Points: recent unique profile activity, outbound clicks and saves in a rolling 7-day window.
